description: Implementation of the CategoryService interface, managing category-related operations such as creation, retrieval, updating, deletion, hierarchy management, and querying within the shopizer e-commerce platform.

classes.name: CategoryServiceImpl
classes.description: Service layer implementation handling business logic related to categories, including hierarchy management and interaction with database via DAOs.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new category, setting lineage and depth based on parent, then updates database.

methods.name: countProductsByCategories
methods.description: Returns a count of products associated with specified categories within a merchant store.

methods.name: listByCodes
methods.description: Retrieves categories matching provided codes for a given store and language.

methods.name: listByIds
methods.description: Retrieves categories by their IDs for a store and language.

methods.name: getByLanguage
methods.description: Returns category localized to a specific language.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Persist the category, creating new or updating existing.

methods.name: listByLineage
methods.description: Lists categories based on their lineage string and store info.

methods.name: listBySeUrl
methods.description: Lists categories associated with a specific SEO URL.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a category by its SEO URL.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a category by its code, within a store or by store code.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a category by its ID.

methods.name: listByParent
methods.description: Lists subcategories of a given category.

methods.name: listByStoreAndParent
methods.description: Lists categories within a store that have a specific parent category.

methods.name: listByDepth
methods.description: Lists categories at a specific depth level.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description for a category in a specific language.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a child category to a parent, setting lineage and depth accordingly.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a category and handles associated product removals and subcategory updates.
